comment: Foley to generate through the sound-effect service API (docs/sfx-service-api.md). Take N of a cue uses seed + N - 1. loopable: true marks an ambience bed (the mixer loops it under a scene); false a discrete sound. Music cues (theme, sting, transition) are not generated: they stay CC0 or hand-made. Spooky, never gory.

cues.prompt: A heavy old wooden door creaks open slowly on rusty iron hinges in a stone hallway.
A heavy oak door slams shut with a deep boom that echoes down a stone corridor.
Three slow, heavy knocks on a thick wooden front door at night.
An old iron key turns stiffly in a heavy lock, then the bolt clunks into place.
A single old floorboard creaks slowly under a careful footstep in a quiet room.
Slow leather-soled footsteps walking across a stone floor in a large echoing hall.
Footsteps climbing old creaking wooden stairs slowly, one step at a time.
Footsteps crunching steadily along a gravel path outdoors at night.
A sudden sharp crack of nearby thunder followed by a long rolling rumble.
A distant low rumble of thunder rolls across open moorland at night, then fades.
Steady heavy rain falling on a roof and against window panes, constant, no thunder.
A cold wind blowing steadily around an old house at night, soft and constant.
A gust of wind howls through a gap in an old window frame, rising and falling once.
A wood fire crackling gently in a stone fireplace, constant soft pops and hiss.
A large old pendulum clock ticking slowly and steadily in a quiet room.
A grandfather clock strikes midnight with slow, deep, resonant chimes.
A single large church bell tolls slowly three times in the distance.
Inside a horse-drawn carriage on a rough road: wooden creaks, rattling, muffled hooves and wheels, constant.
A horse-drawn carriage rattles past over cobblestones, wheels and hooves, passing by.
Several horses gallop hard along a dirt road, approaching and passing.
A nervous horse whinnies and snorts, stamping its hooves.
A pack of wolves howling together far away in a mountain forest at night.
A dog barking several times far away in a village at night.
An owl hoots twice in a dark forest at night, quiet surroundings.
The quick leathery flapping of a bat's wings flying close past, then away.
A quiet forest at night: soft breeze in the trees, distant crickets, an occasional rustle, constant.
Waves breaking on a rocky shore at night with a steady sea wind, constant.
The wooden hull and rigging of a sailing ship creaking and groaning in a rolling sea.
Water dripping slowly in a cold stone crypt with a faint hollow echo, constant.
A slow, steady, muffled human heartbeat, low and deep, as if heard through floorboards.
A match is struck and flares up, then burns softly.
A candle flame is blown out with a soft breath, a faint hiss of smoke.
An old metal lantern creaks as it swings on its handle while someone walks.
A heavy iron chain rattles and drags across a stone floor.
A window pane shatters and glass falls onto a wooden floor.
A heavy stone lid slowly scrapes open on a stone tomb, grinding.
